title: Environment Management Act 2010 (Act 27 of 2010)
citation: Environment Management Act 2010 (Act 27 of 2010), Cap. 21.03 in the 2020 Revised Edition; assented 27 August 2010
evidence: The 2020 Revised Edition (https://ago.gov.to/cms/images/LEGISLATION/PRINCIPAL/2010/2010-0027/EnvironmentManagementAct_3.pdf, opened 2026-11-03) prints under the long title "Commencement [30 August 2010]"; the Act as first published prints "I assent, GEORGE TUPOU V, 27th August 2010"; the Legislation History Table gives Version 1 "Date Commenced: Monday, 30 August 2010".
notes: Mapped to F2: the register row carried F7; the Act is the environmental framework act (Ministry of Environment and Climate Change, protection and management of the environment, sustainable development), not a climate-specific or company-disclosure law. It contains no greenhouse gas reporting or carbon duty; the duties on private persons are environmental (permits, pollution, waste). official_url is the PDF of the current English version: the iLAWS site has no page of its own for an Act, only the Legislation History Table row on https://ago.gov.to/cms/legislation/current-revised-edition/by-category.html (category 'Environment' or 'Commerce'), which links the PDFs. The Tongan PDF of the same version sits beside the English one (same folder, file name ending x.pdf). Versions: the Legislation History Table lists Version 1 (as first published), Version 2 (Revised Edition, Date Commenced 2016-12-31) and Version 3 (2020 Revised Edition, 2020-12-04, the current file); each is stored in English and Tongan with the record in_force set to that date. The site says it consolidates the law to 31 October 2020. Languages stored on 2026-11-03: en and to (Tongan), both enacted by the King and the Legislative Assembly and served by the Attorney General's Office under the same row as the English file; no separate translation row. No separate government English translation exists (the English file is itself an enacted text); looked for on ago.gov.to (Legislation History Table and the Index by Category) and on parliament.gov.to (Acts Passed). Related, not in scope: Environment Management (Litter and Waste Control) Regulations 2016 (F7).

title: Consumer Protection Act 2000 (Act 15 of 2000)
citation: Consumer Protection Act 2000 (Act 15 of 2000), Cap. 17.04 in the 2020 Revised Edition; assented 7 November 2000
evidence: The 2016 and 2020 Revised Editions (https://ago.gov.to/cms/images/LEGISLATION/PRINCIPAL/2000/2000-0015/ConsumerProtectionAct_3.pdf, opened 2026-11-03) print "Commencement [2nd July 2001]". Section 1(2) of the Act as first published: "This Act shall come into force on a date to be proclaimed by His Majesty in Council." The proclamation itself was not found on the site.
notes: Umbrella for misleading claims by traders: s. 22 (misleading or deceptive conduct, an offence) and s. 23 (false representations about goods and services). The Act does not mention environmental or climate claims. official_url is the PDF of the current English version: the iLAWS site has no page of its own for an Act, only the Legislation History Table row on https://ago.gov.to/cms/legislation/current-revised-edition/by-category.html (category 'Environment' or 'Commerce'), which links the PDFs. The site says it consolidates the law to 31 October 2020. Repealed by section 148(1) of the Consumer Protection Act 2025 (to-consumer-protection-act-2025) once that Act is proclaimed; until then this Act stays in force. title: Consumer Protection Act 2025 (Act 39 of 2025)
citation: Consumer Protection Act 2025 (Act 39 of 2025), assented 16 December 2025, Gazette Supplement GAZ_SE 17/25 of 17 December 2025; passed by the Legislative Assembly 18 September 2025
evidence: Section 1(2) (https://ago.gov.to/cms/images/LEGISLATION/PRINCIPAL/2025/2025-0053/ConsumerProtectionAct2025_1.pdf, opened 2026-11-03): "This Act shall come into force on a day to be proclaimed by Cabinet."; the Legislation History Table note: "This Act shall come into force on a day to be proclaimed by Cabinet". No proclamation was found on the site (the Not in Force page https://ago.gov.to/cms/legislation/not-in-force.html does not list it either), so no official page states a commencement date.
notes: Replaces the Consumer Protection Act 2000 (s. 148(1) repeals Cap. 17.04; the Product Safety & Labelling Standards Regulations continue under s. 148(2)). Section 61 prohibits misleading or deceptive conduct in trade and section 62 unsubstantiated representations about goods or services, with pecuniary penalties; neither names environmental claims. Not stored: a record needs a first in-force date and none is stated, and an Act not yet in force is not part of the law in force on a date.
